text:
`Project extends Task` is merged into `michael/dev`. Its new `Project.test.mjs` passes 8 of 8, and `Task.test.mjs` still passes 53 of 53. The review was size `none` with a stated reason, and I ran the merge with `--skip-smoke` as the brief said, so no browser smoke test ran. I never loaded the class on a live page.

The class is in `core/Task/Project.js`. It walks the six stages with `advance()`: the approval stage waits on the owner and the work stage starts the clock. `completed` (0 to 1) is computed from the subtasks, and landing is refused while any subtask is open. Nothing is wired in, and the only other change is one line in `core/Task/readme.md`.

I also appended the review line to the main tree's `task.jsonl`, because `merge.mjs` reads the review from there rather than from the worktree.

Done: `Project extends Task` (`core/Task/Project.js`, plus `Project.test.mjs` and a line in the Task readme) is merged into `michael/dev`, and its own tests pass 8 of 8. Nothing is wired into State, Servex or any page, and I'm not working on anything now.

The landing line is appended to `task.jsonl`. I did not call `card_reply`.

On the two readme questions:
1. **Module readme:** yes. `core/Task/readme.md` now lists `Project.js` as a play class wired nowhere.
2. **Parent readme:** the framework readme only indexes `core/Task` as a whole, so that line needed no change.

`Project extends Task` is merged into `michael/dev`: six stages and a `completed` value from 0 to 1 computed from the subtasks. `Project.test.mjs` passes 8 of 8 and `Task.test.mjs` still passes 53 of 53. Nothing is wired in, and I skipped the browser smoke test (`--skip-smoke`) as the brief said.
